summary: Aggravated penetrative sexual assault (POCSO Act); victim under twelve; High Court erred in reducing sentence to seven years; plain reading of Section 5(m) attracts aggravated offense; minimum ten-year sentence mandatory per Section 6; Special Court conviction correct; High Court judgment set aside; original ten-year sentence restored; surrender within one month ordered.
legal_provisions_cited: POCSO Act s.2(a), s.3(a), s.4, s.5(m), s.6 (pre-16.08.2019 version)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment quashed; Trial Court judgment restored; respondent to serve remaining sentence of ten years with fine of Rs.5,000; surrender within one month or face warrant.
